decisions.reason: As a flagship digital intake and consent product line tightly linked to the core practice software and the firm's digital strategy, it would normally be retained rather than withdrawn.
The remote screen-sharing support tool is a practical complement to implementation and customer service, though it is more replaceable than core clinical-administrative software.

A practice performance analytics dashboard fits the firm's move toward more efficient and data-driven practice management, so it is likely to stay even if later integrated more deeply into the main platform.
A complete dental practice bundle is very close to the established business and should remain attractive as a packaged offer for new and existing practices.

A job and practice listing portal is comparatively distant from the firm's core software business and is the most plausible candidate to be discontinued so resources can be focused on core products and new development.
